title: "Design kalimba FM oscillator"
design:
Draft kalimba synthesis plan:
1. Analyze fm_bell baseline and desired kalimba timbre.
2. Implement new oscillator with plucked envelope, tuned modulation, and optional attack noise.
3. Provide manifest and README updates, build assets if needed.
notes: Implemented new fm_kalimba oscillator with curated tine ratios, body follower, and attack noise. Updated docs and manifest; build blocked locally due to missing ARM GCC toolchain.

title: "Investigate minilogue build toolchain"
description: "Identify required toolchain/setup to run Makefiles locally; check README or Docker instructions."
notes: Local make fails because the ARM GCC toolchain expected at logue-sdk/tools/gcc/gcc-arm-none-eabi-5_4-2016q3/ is not present. README + logue-sdk/tools/gcc/README.md explain running get_gcc_macos.sh to install, or use logue-sdk/docker scripts (build_image.sh + scripts/build.sh) to build via Docker.

title: "Add fm_kalimba to web preview"
description: "Create manifest and register new kalimba oscillator so dev_preview can compile it for browser testing."
notes: Added fm_kalimba manifest and fallback implementation so dev_preview can load it. Updated wasm build scripts and preview build tool to compile all oscillators.

title: "Make dev_preview tolerant of missing Emscripten"
description: "Allow preview script to skip WASM rebuild when emcc is unavailable so JS fallback still works."
notes: dev_preview now continues when a build script fails (e.g., missing emcc) and advises using --skip-build or installing Emscripten.

title: "Refine FM Bell and FM Kalimba defaults"
description: "Adjust default decay and shape mapping for fm_bell; improve fm_kalimba parameter behavior (decay, brightness/body/noise), lower base pitch, clarify manifest labels."
notes: Set fm_bell default decay to ~13%, added shared helpers, and mapped the Shape knob to the mod decay envelope. Revoiced fm_kalimba: lower base octave, stronger envelope/brightness/noise responses, renamed Harmonics control, and refreshed preview fallbacks/docs.

title: Map Minilogue ADSR to FM Bell
Shape/ShiftShape macros for FM Bell
design:
Steps:
1. Restore ratio mapping to 1-20.
2. Split mod decay into base+macro helper.
3. Reduce amp decay floor to subtle value.
4. Rebuild locally to sanity check compile.
